description: A sanitizer nested in the arguments of an unlabelled outer call (`subprocess.Popen` is a gated sink with no flat label) cleans only its own result. It must not replace the call's callee, or the gate is lost: html.escape and basename leave shell syntax in place, so the Popen sink still fires; shlex.quote is the shell sanitizer and keeps the call clean.

expected.notes: html.escape nested in a Popen argv still reaches the shell
basename nested in a Popen argv still reaches the shell
shlex.quote nested in the argv is the shell sanitizer
